Which kind of joke makes you laugh hardest?
Deadpan, dry wit / Dark or morbid jokes / Wordplay and puns / other / Absurd, surreal humor / Physical comedy and pratfalls / Observations about everyday life

When a group conversation gets awkward, what do you usually do?
other / Crack a joke to ease it / Stay quiet and wait / Tease someone playfully / Make fun of yourself

What role do you usually play when your friends are joking around?
other / The one roasting others / The one laughing / The one telling the jokes / The one who stays serious / The one others joke about

Which humor do you use most with people you just met?
other / Sarcasm / Light, friendly jokes / Jokes at your own expense / None until you know them better

When something bad happens to you, how do you usually use humor?
Rarely joke about your own troubles / other / Joke about it only much later / Joke so people won't see you are upset / Find the funny side to cope

What makes a joke fall flat for you most often?
other / It is too mean / It is too crude / The timing is off / It tries too hard to be clever / It is too predictable

How do you react when someone makes a joke at your expense?
Tell them it wasn't funny / Shrug it off / Feel hurt but hide it / Fire one back / Laugh along

Which do you find funnier: a clever one-liner or a long, rambling story that builds up?
one_liner / long_story

Do you laugh more at jokes that are clever or jokes that are silly?
silly / clever

How often do you use sarcasm in everyday conversation?
Almost never / Only with close friends / A few times in most conversations / It is how you talk most of the time

How dark can a joke get before you stop finding it funny?
Any joke about death or tragedy puts you off / Mild gallows humor is fine / You enjoy most dark jokes / Almost nothing is too dark for you

How much do you enjoy puns and wordplay?
You groan and wish people would stop / You tolerate them / You smile at a good one / You make them constantly

child.label: Humor Habits & Tastes
child.description: Questions about how the answerer uses and enjoys humor, such as teasing, self-deprecating jokes, joking under stress, and preferred kinds of jokes, including self-description statements.
child.not_for: Rating how funny one specific supplied joke is (use Joke Ratings).
examples: Do you use humor to cope with stress?
Do you prefer clever jokes or silly ones?
